data.narrative:
The Bot Company is a Series B-stage robotics and manufacturing platform founded by Kyle Vogt, Paril Jain, and Luke Holoubek, with approximately $550M in total capital raised to date. The peer universe comprises nine comparable companies across robotics and manufacturing: one public entity (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private firms, including Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Divergent, and Exotec.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $550M raised as a proxy for current value, then applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $1.0B. Peer-median benchmarking across three same-stage, same-sector comparables—Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B)—produces a median valuation of $1.8B, with a range of $1.6B to $2.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $888M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $1.4B. The gap between stage-progression ($1.0B) and peer-median ($1.8B) reflects uncertainty around comparable company selection and the representativeness of raised capital as a valuation proxy. Key risks include the limited size of the robotics peer set, variance in revenue multiples across stage-comparable firms, and the company's specific unit economics relative to identified peers.
